scope: Construction, testing and acceptance of 6 explicitly selected MH-RC-1800x1200-H3.0-C30/37-D400-DN300 cast-in-place reinforced-concrete rectangular access manholes. Structural concrete, reinforcement, formwork, waterstops, covers and frames, steps, connectors, seals, benching, waterproofing, bedding, earthworks, labor, mechanisms, QA and logistics are direct project inputs.
sourceAuthority: Approved sewerage and structural design organizations, concrete, reinforcement and cover suppliers, geotechnical engineer, construction laboratory and approving project engineer
projectDocumentsRequired: approved manhole layout, structural drawings, elevations, depths and connection schedule
approved concrete, reinforcement, formwork, waterstop, cover, frame, step, seal and connector specification
approved benching, waterproofing and bedding schedule
approved excavation, backfill and excess-soil quantities
construction method with labor and mechanism quantities
survey, concrete-quality, watertightness and acceptance program
conditional dewatering, excavation-shoring and pavement-restoration schedules
supplier cover-kit package quantity and approved retained spare-cover quantity
forbiddenClaims: whole sewer pipe or network scope inherited from a route template
manhole count or spacing derived from route length
concrete, reinforcement, formwork, earthwork, labor or mechanism quantities derived from a universal coefficient
automatic dewatering, shoring or pavement restoration
universal spare-cover or supplier package quantity
